free.title: Free Forever
free.description: Core wellness features will always be free. Lantern (confessions), Daily Rituals, Crisis Support, and Miracle Feed are accessible to everyone—no credit card required.
free.noPaywall: We will never block mental health support behind a paywall.

cancel.a: Yes. Cancel anytime from your account settings. No questions asked, no hidden fees.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We accept all major credit cards via Stripe. Your payment information is never stored on our servers.

refund.a: Yes. If you're not satisfied within the first 7 days, we'll refund you in full—no questions asked.

tesla.a: Inspired by Nikola Tesla's belief in the sacred power of 3, 6, and 9. These numbers represent energy, frequency, and vibration—the foundation of all creation.

data.q: What happens to my data if I cancel?
data.a: Your account remains active (free tier). If you delete your account, all data is permanently removed within 30 days.
